newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X confirms joint Busang proposal.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X confirms joint Busang proposal.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd confirmed on Monday that it and Barrick Gold Corp have presented a joint submission to the Indonesian government to develop the Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
Barrick Gold said earlier on Monday that the two companies had presented Indonesia with a joint submission.
The government is expected to respond to Bre-X and Barrick "in due course," Bre-X said in its statement.
Bre-X and Barrick did not release any details about their arrangement, but Barrick spokesman Vince Borg said it was in line with the Indonesian government's requests.
The Indonesian government asked Bre-X and Barrick to form a joint venture to develop the Busang deposit discovered by Bre-X.
The government suggested that Barrick get 75 percent, Bre-X keep 25 percent and the two companies arrange for the government to get a 10 percent piece.
The deposit contains at least 57 million ounces of gold and has the potential to be one of the world's biggest gold mines, analysts have said.
